43537bed.text:
Day 3

Centaur have invaded Mulgore! Our most vile and ancient enemy has dared re-enter these plains after being driven out. The High Chieftain's fury will rain upon them!

I must know what they plan, so that we may counter it most effectively. If I stay silent I think I can get close enough to overhear them.

It seems they plan to...

<The rest of the text is covered in blood.>
43537bed.title: Longwalker Malah's Report

78feb5dc.text:

78feb5dc.title: Horde Military Ranks

9cdab8f9.text:
These demon plates were worn by the creature that first cursed our people with bloodlust. By the heroic act of one brave orc - he was defeated. Mannoroth the Destructor is no more. Let these plates always remind us of how far we've come and how hard we fought to regain our honor.

- Thrall, Warchief of the Horde
9cdab8f9.title: The Armor of Mannoroth

e93efd40.text:
Day 1

Venture Co. activity continues to be a concern. Their mining operations have only grown, and I hear a new, grinding sound that suggests some new horrific construct may have been unloaded there.

I do not yet consider them a capable threat to Thunder Bluff, but if provoked they could successfully mount an attack on Bloodhoof Village from the south.
e93efd40.title: Longwalker Malah's Report

fcf55805.text:
Day 2

I hear a thunderous, stampeding sound echoing off the cliffs to the east, where our home meets the plains of the Barrens. It may be yet another zhevra or gazelle herd, or perhaps an enraged thunder lizard, but it continues deeper into the night than such beasts typically stay active.

I will push forward to investigate further, but will maintain a safe distance.
fcf55805.title: Longwalker Malah's Report

10266|6e63d362.name: Ug'thok
10266|6e63d362.text: You learn quickly, that is not a bad thing. Just be sure to do the job right, as long as it takes to do so. Now, I fear I must send you to Snarl to learn more. Learn what he can teach, but do not listen to his angry words. He gets that way when Saru's daughters laugh at him.

10278|46a7802e.name: Thrag Stonehoof
10278|46a7802e.text: Karn says we need to listen to the spirits of the forge and of the steel, that they will guide us. I hear nothing but a ringing in my ears. Here, take a hammer and let us try to hear the spirits together.

10278|af34ad47.name: Thrag Stonehoof
10278|af34ad47.text: I guess the spirits like you better than me, I still have not heard their call but you seem to have gathered their lessons well. Go speak to Karn, he will be excited to see one who hears them as he does.

10378|5d1f9ab4.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|5d1f9ab4.text: Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $N.

10378|8b4f80e7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|8b4f80e7.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

11046|28b8dee2.name: Whuut
11046|28b8dee2.text: Why should I pace myself if this is working?

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

11868|48da0bbc.name: Sayoc
11868|48da0bbc.text: Here to learn how to wield a new weapon, or just to waste my time?

11869|49ff395c.name: Ansekhwa
11869|49ff395c.text: I would be honored to train you in the use of the weapons that I have mastered should you have the ability to learn within you.

15116|19dfe25a.name: Grinkle
15116|19dfe25a.text:
Hey Hey Hey!  I am here to promote a fabulous fishing tournament in Stranglethorn but you need to be tough enough to survive there and have enough skill in fishing to fish those waters.

 Come back later when you are more qualified!

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

205729|2fb0f637.name: Boarton Shadetotem
205729|2fb0f637.text:
Most impressive that you have noticed me, $r. You may have a talent for the shadows.

I am Boarton Shadetotem, a master of the arts of stealth and subtlety. You may find the idea of a $r rogue implausible, even impossible. For many years I took pride that my skills were mine alone. But I have seen my people face unimaginable challenges, and I now feel a duty to share my knowledge with the tribe.

2121|bf7b697c.name: Shadow Priest Allister
2121|bf7b697c.text: Information... With our scouts and agents, we control the flow of information in Lordaeron. Scourge movements, their holdings, all underneath our watchful eyes...

268048|53fff4bc.name: Darkspear Emissary
268048|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

2704|15da2919.name: Hanashi
2704|15da2919.text: Heya mon.  You come right place learn how ta wield a new weapon.

2798|a28d29e1.name: Pand Stonebinder
2798|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

2988|00c35128.name: Morin Cloudstalker
2988|00c35128.text: The Outrunners' duty is to ensure the safety of those who travel across the plains of Mulgore. Those that would threaten the safety of the $r homeland risk punishment at our hands.

2993|f7a5deb4.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993|f7a5deb4.text: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.

2998|19ec09c0.name: Karn Stonehoof
2998|19ec09c0.text: Everything has a spirit, if you learn to listen to it you can get it to take any shape you want. Blacksmithing isn't about beating metal, forcing it to do your will. It's about listening to the spirit within the steel and guiding it to the shape you know it wants to take.

3026|0c543544.name: Aska Mistrunner
3026|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3052|25d0fbd5.name: Skorn Whitecloud
3052|25d0fbd5.text: Come closer, young one.  In my time I could hear the flutter of a prey's beating heart, but now you must speak up if you want your words heard.

3052|c5cfc7da.name: Skorn Whitecloud
3052|c5cfc7da.text:
I have run through these plains for many, many seasons.  And I have hunted great beasts.  And I had never been bested... until I faced Ghost Howl.

Long ago, the massive wolf was an ally to the $r and fought bravely against the Burning Legion.  But he was wounded savagely by a demon, and the tear in his flesh never healed.  Eventually... it drove Ghost Howl mad.

Now he roams the plains in agony, seeking an end to his pain.  To my shame, when we fought I lacked the strength to slay him...

3057|690a7170.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057|690a7170.text:
Greetings young one, and welcome to Thunder Bluff.  You'll find safe refuge from the burdens of the world here.  All denizens of the Horde are welcome here.

The spirits of the present and past come alive here in this sacred place, my friend.  Honor them, and in doing so honor yourself.

3063|4711dbab.name: Krang Stonehoof
3063|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3065|2d23ed1c.name: Yaw Sharpmane
3065|2d23ed1c.text: I do not have the knowledge you seek.

3084|ea04b75c.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|ea04b75c.text: The Earth Mother holds many secrets and Brek Stonehoof can help you to discover some of them.  You will find him on the lower rise at Stonehoof Geology.

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3216|1672ee12.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|1672ee12.text:
Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!

Look at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.

3216|2e9c14b6.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|2e9c14b6.text: Haha! Save for their leaders--the satyr, Bazzalan, and the warlock Jergosh--yes, all of them. That is why I constantly send Thrall's worshippers at them. It gives Thrall the impression that I am weeding out the evil in the bowels of his great city. The victory is in reality two-fold: kill Thrall's faithful and test the strength of those in the Searing Blade to see if they are truly worthy of joining me.

3216|9353e287.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|9353e287.text:
Ah, one of our own. It is good to see our numbers are growing so rapidly that I can no longer keep track of the faces of our members.

That fool Thrall thinks I am working hard to cleanse the image of warlocks and prove we are his servants. Idiot! The Burning Legion will make ash of this entire world after it drains it completely.

3216|e0c203bc.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|e0c203bc.text: I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3347|9cc6e14a.name: Yelmak
3347|9cc6e14a.text: I'm busy, $N. Tell Whuut to handle whatever it is. That young pup has been stewing all day long. He spends much more time like that, and he's going to hurt something.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4949|9255c79c.name: Thrall
4949|9255c79c.text:
It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.

Know this first and foremost: our enemy is the Shadow Council. No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.

Many cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.

Groups like the Burning Blade, the Argus Wake, and the Searing Blade are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5769|c9ae2675.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c9ae2675.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

5811|6fac1a00.name: Kamari
5811|6fac1a00.text: You like the rug? I killed and skinned the beast myself. May all the centaur fall as easily.

5938|c2467ddc.name: Uthan Stillwater
5938|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

5939|a28d29e1.name: Vira Younghoof
5939|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6251|86b6c1ef.name: Strahad Farsan
6251|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

6252|e051db5c.name: Acolyte Magaz
6252|e051db5c.text: Listen to your elders, $N. If you are strong of will and dedicated, there is no power you cannot control.

6254|b22c7e43.name: Acolyte Wytula
6254|b22c7e43.text: Not all Forsaken are driven by Sylvanas' will, $N. Some of us are driven by true power--power we earn for ourselves.

6266|7023447d.name: Menara Voidrender
6266|7023447d.text:
Kar Aman, $N. You look to be a strong $c--you would do well to mind yourself in this area. Touching things you know nothing about, or showing disrespect to your elders is just cause for punishment.

You may not respect me or my companions, but you will learn to respect our power if you prove foolish enough.

Now, enough with the pleasantries, was there something I can do for you?

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6747|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Kauth
6747|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

7231|248686cb.name: Kelgruk Bloodaxe
7231|248686cb.text: What is it? Can't you see I'm busy?

1498-progress.name: Uzzek
1498-progress.text: Do you have the scales, $N?  Unless you can withstand the attacks of the thunder lizards, you will not benefit from my instruction.
1498-progress.title: Path of Defense

1503-progress.name: Thun'grim Firegaze
1503-progress.text: Do you have my steel bars?
1503-progress.title: Forged Steel

756-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-progress.text: $N, do you have the claws I sent you to gather? The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!
756-progress.title: Thunderhorn Totem

76156-progress.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76156-progress.text: We'll need to work on your stealth skills, $c. I heard you approaching as soon as you set foot on the mesa.
76156-progress.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

765-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
765-progress.text: I seethe with anger at the thought of the atrocities the Venture Co. is willing to perpetrate against us in the name of profit.
765-progress.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket

96130-progress.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-progress.text: Have you found the big wolf?
96130-progress.title: Chakuyak

97928-complete.name: Thrag Stonehoof
97928-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Sharpening Wheel. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97928-complete.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

98424-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
98424-progress.text: What is it you bring me, $c?
98424-progress.title: Fizsprocket's Notes
